datasets.label: TestSet300
datasets.description: Primary held-out benchmark (<20% sequence identity to development data).

datasets.label: TestSetNew46
datasets.description: Newer PDB entries, held out from every model's development.

adabind.label: AdaBind
adabind.note: Ligand-class-specific ensembles; thresholds locked on DevSet1010 out-of-fold predictions.

bindEmbed21DL.label: bindEmbed21DL
bindEmbed21DL.note: ProtT5 + 2-layer CNN, 5 checkpoints averaged; fixed 0.5 (published operating point).

bindNode24.label: bindNode24
bindNode24.note: ProtT5 + GraphSAGE on AlphaFold structures, 5 folds averaged; fixed 0.5 (published operating point).

notes.thresholds: AUPRC and AUROC do not depend on the threshold and compare the three models directly. Precision, recall, F1 and MCC compare AdaBind at its locked threshold with the baselines at 0.5.
notes.dnaRna: bindEmbed21DL and bindNode24 predict nucleic-acid binding as one class, without separating DNA from RNA. Their nucleic-acid output is scored against the DNA and RNA labels.
notes.labels: DNA and RNA labels come from the nucleic-acid labels: BioLiP2 says which nucleic acid each protein binds, and that protein's binding residues take that label.
notes.structure: Structures are the ESMFold models AdaBind was evaluated on. bindNode24's frozen predictions were made on AlphaFold structures.
